project.name: Muir of Pert
project.boundarySource: HES NRHE Tealing Airfield/Muir of Pert point with a conservative editorial buffer
project.researchNotes: Project created for the 2026-09-01 full sequential audit. Only records inside the strict locality study boundary may be assigned. Angus-wide full audit completed 2026-09-01: all six visitor categories, the four named commercial trail providers, current official/conventional routes, strict-boundary scoring and local HES/NRHE integrity were checked.
